thread:
Maya Thompson: Flagging a mismatch on the Azure marketplace settlement for reseller BlueHarbor. Partner statement shows a 12-hour peak window billed separately (overnight batch) that doesn't appear on our consolidated invoice. PDF: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/azure/2026-11/BH-INV-1119.pdf
Ethan Brooks: can you confirm which metercode/period? cc @Rina Kapoor
Maya Thompson: partner metercode `az.peak_gpu.hourly` for 2026-11-02T00:00-12:00Z appears in their export but missing in our ingestion.
Rina Kapoor: pulling partner export now. quick grep shows entries but with timezone tag `tz=UTC+10`. our importer normalizes timestamps to UTC but there's a bug when tz offset != 0 and period rolls to previous day.
partner-billing: we did export those peak lines intentionally as a separate settlement bucket. attaching redacted CSV link.
Ethan Brooks: rough exposure?
Rina Kapoor: looks like ~420 GPU hours at our effective partner rate -> ~$6,300.
Maya Thompson: @finance-bot please create a tracking ticket and place provisional hold for $7k while we reconcile.
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-4902. Provisional hold placed for $7,000. Auto-collection paused for BlueHarbor for Nov.
Rina Kapoor: quick snippet (redacted):
```
timestamp,metercode,usage,notes
2026-11-02T08:00:00+10:00,az.peak_gpu.hourly,420,overnight-peak
```
Our parser dropped lines where tz != Z due to a library edge-case.
Ethan Brooks: billing-ops - can you re-run ingestion with strict ISO parser and post diffs? ETA?
billing-ops: running corrected importer on a canary subset now. ETA ~45m.
partner-billing: FYI we export in local TZ for some partners to make reconciliation easier on their side. we'll standardize to UTC by next week.
Rina Kapoor: canary import complete - reconciles the 420 hours. attaching reconciliation CSV to FIN-4902. Minor rounding delta -> actual billable = 418.6 hours -> $6,283.40.
Maya Thompson: OK recommend provisional approval to net up to $6,500.
Ethan Brooks: Approving provisional up to $6,500 and instruct ops to issue credit memo when FIN-4902 is signed off. :+1:
finance-bot: Provisional credit memo generated and attached to FIN-4902. Status: awaiting audit sign-off.
partner-billing: thanks. we've accepted the reconciliation and will update our exporter to use UTC. will confirm when ledger is finalized.
billing-ops: production import scheduled with fix at 2026-11-10T02:30Z. will post final audit once complete.
Maya Thompson: thanks team. action item for experiments/product: add timezone test vectors to ingestion test suite to avoid this class of errors.
Ethan Brooks: noted. closing slack thread after FIN-4902 resolved. :white_check_mark:
